title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Mystic Lake Casino Hotel, Prior Lake | 2008
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Mystic Lake Casino Hotel in Prior Lake, Minnesota, USA, on 14 July 2008.

It was the 18th show by the tenth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 29 dates between June and August 2008.

Starr returned to the Mystic Lake Casino Hotel on 25 July 2010, 22 August 2019, and 1 October 2023.

The tenth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Gary Wright: vocals, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
